tools.name: random_joke
tools.description: Get a random joke. Can be a general joke, a programming joke, or a Chuck Norris joke. Use when the user asks for a joke or something funny.

type.description: Type of joke (default: 'general' for a random joke)

tools.name: random_fact
tools.description: Get a random fun/interesting fact or trivia. Use when the user asks for an interesting fact, 'tell me something interesting', or 'did you know' type questions.

tools.name: random_quote
tools.description: Get a random inspirational or famous quote with author attribution. Use when the user asks for a quote, motivation, or wisdom.

tag.description: Optional tag to filter quotes by topic, e.g. 'wisdom', 'love', 'success', 'motivational'
